verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a reasonable feature for a workflow platform's dashboard, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside Inngest that users can hand tasks to. The MCP server and CLI let external coding agents operate Inngest, AgentKit and the agent-loop guides are frameworks for developers to build their own agents, and AI Overview is a metrics dashboard rather than an assistant. None of these count as a built-in delegatable assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
